name: 2027-28 Teacher Planner (US school year)

listing.title: 2027-28 Teacher Planner for US Classroom Teachers - Printable Monthly Calendar, August 2027 to July 2028
listing.description:
A dated school-year planner for classroom teachers in the US.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, a 2027-28 year-at-a-glance page and 12 monthly calendar pages from August 2027 to July 2028 (weeks start on Sunday). Every month page has This month's focus, Key dates and Notes boxes. Two extra pages: a Class Roster page and a Semester Overview page for the fall and spring semesters.

Print it on A4 or US Letter paper.

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Write first and last days of each semester on the Semester Overview page.
Keep the Class Roster page at the front of your folder.
